authority: CEO Round 159: 'C2-Y V2: Before running anything: Freeze all alarm thresholds, baseline definition, response-manifold parameters, failure definitions, patient distribution, noise, drift, posture, failure onset, classifier, model selection, train/validation/test split. No parameter can be changed after observing V2 results.'
constitutional_basis: Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (ALL parameters frozen BEFORE execution)
Article XXVII — no threshold invention (every threshold has provenance)
Article XXIX — separate implementation failure from mechanism failure
EXPERIMENT_VALIDITY_GATE_V1 (this round) — all 7 conditions must pass
purpose: Round 158 C2-Y-R1 was INVALID because alarm thresholds, latch, and drift compensation were tuned during debugging (Article XIX violation). This V2 pre-registration freezes ALL numerical parameters, including those that were missing from V1. No parameter may be changed after this file is committed.

disease_progression_model.step_duration_hours: uniform(6, 72) per step, randomized per patient
disease_progression_model.clinical_failure_definition: ICP > 25 mmHg sustained > 1 hour (for high-ICP modes); ICP < 0 mmHg sustained > 1 hour (for overdrainage); either (for valve_dysfunction, posture_artifact)

train_test_split.split_method: First 180 patients (60%) = training (threshold tuning); last 120 patients (40%) = test (frozen threshold applied)
train_test_split.stratification: Stratified by failure_mode × sensor_noise_bucket to ensure balanced distribution

UISB_baseline_A_parameters_FROZEN.fidelity_check: UISB reproduction must match VIEshunt-published ICP error response (Figure 4-5 of PMID 40087797) within 20%. If exceeds 20%, experiment is BLOCKED per Article XXIX.

alarm_thresholds_FROZEN.threshold_tuning_method: Tuned on TRAINING cohort (60% = 180 patients) to achieve approximately 1 FA/patient-month. Threshold frozen before TEST cohort (40% = 120 patients) execution.
alarm_thresholds_FROZEN.threshold_provenance: These thresholds were NOT in V1 pre-registration. They are now frozen in V2. Per Article XIX, no post-hoc adjustment.

classifier_parameters_FROZEN.type: threshold-based on latest alarm ICP + trend

primary_endpoint_FROZEN.mathematical_definition: Lead time (hours) = t_clinical_failure - t_first_alarm, conditioned on FPR = 1 FA/patient-month over the patient-month horizon
primary_endpoint_FROZEN.operating_point_selection: Each arm's alert threshold tuned on TRAINING cohort (180 patients) to achieve FPR target. Threshold frozen for TEST cohort (120 patients).

the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_1_naive_threshold: Static ICP threshold alarm (NAIVE_THRESHOLD_MMHG = 30 mmHg), no controller, no response-manifold features
the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_2_UISB_baseline: VIEshunt-style PI controller (Kp=0.15, Ki=0.02) + Codman-style threshold alarm (UISB_THRESHOLD_MMHG = 27 mmHg) + Nature-style chronic ICP sensor with drift compensation
the_three_arms_FROZEN.arm_3_C2_Y_candidate: UISB baseline + response-manifold deviation predictor (rolling_std over 60min, threshold 8 mmHg, 7-day latch)

mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.authority: CEO Round 159: 'Round 159 should first determine whether the response-manifold method has a mechanism-specific domain of superiority. Which failure classes are theoretically observable from dynamic response before conventional pressure thresholds, and which are fundamentally not?'
mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.analysis_approach: Report results SEPARATELY by failure mode. Do NOT hide failure-mode weaknesses inside an aggregate score.
mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.failure_mode_table_format: | Failure mode | Lead time | False alarms | Classification | Verdict |
mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.scientific_kill_condition: C2-Y does not produce a clinically meaningful early-warning advantage for ANY strategically important failure class under a fixed false-alarm constraint → KILL C2-Y
mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.conditional_survival_condition: If C2-Y clearly works for ONE failure class but not others → create a NARROW SUCCESSOR (e.g., C2-Y-overdrainage-prediction or C2-Y-valve-dysfunction-prediction), NOT a broad C2-Y promotion. Then attack that narrow mechanism.
mechanism_specific_domain_analysis.do_not_rescue_by_inventing_new_indicatio: If C2-Y fails broadly, do NOT rescue it by inventing a new indication after the result. Kill it cleanly.

what_is_FORBIDDEN_after_V2_results_are_k: Changing any parameter in this file (Article XIX)
Re-running with different random seed and reporting only the best (Article XIX)
Excluding specific patients or failure modes from the analysis (Article XXXII)
Adding post-hoc secondary endpoints and presenting them as primary (Article XXVIII)
Inventing a new indication for C2-Y after seeing V2 results (CEO Round 159 directive)
Promoting C2-Y broadly if it only works for one failure class (must create narrow successor instead)
